# Engines by RAM

<!-- Generated by scripts/reference-docs.sh (scripts/engines.py docs) from scripts/engines.manifest.json and scripts/engines.lock. Do not edit by hand: change the manifest and run scripts/reference-docs.sh (the pre-commit hook fails when this file is stale). -->

Regista picks a tier from the Mac's memory (force it with `scripts/install.sh --tier base|medium|pro`). Each tier
adds to the one before. **Installer** = installed by `scripts/install.sh` on that tier; **asked** = optional, the
installer asks; **Homebrew** = installed with Homebrew by the installer; **first use** = downloaded by the engine
the first time it is needed; **manual** = set up by hand; **macOS** = part of the system; **cloud** = a paid web
service. Disk is the installed size (`?` = not known yet).

**What it unlocks** is what needs the engine: while it is missing (or the Mac's tier is too low) the app keeps those
features visible but greyed, with the reason, and Settings › Engines lists every engine with its state and installs
the ones the installer can add.
The `id` is the one engines.status and `scripts/install.sh --only <id>` use.

| Tier | RAM | Installer installs | Disk they take | Free disk the installer asks for | Everything on this tier, optional and manual included |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Base | 8 GB | 7 items | 1.96 GB | 4 GB | 13 items, 2.54 GB + unknown: Your sound effects, Higgsfield |
| Medium | 16 GB | 17 items | 13.31 GB | 16 GB | 26 items, 15.59 GB + unknown: Your sound effects, Higgsfield |
| Pro | 32 GB | 18 items | 13.31 GB | 16 GB | 32 items, 86.15 GB + unknown: Your sound effects, Higgsfield |

The free disk asked for = what the installer installs on that tier + a margin of 2 GB (headroom for the install itself: the 1.6 GB source of the faster-whisper conversion (deleted afterwards), the download cache and logs).

## Shipped inside a release build

A release build (`scripts/release.sh`) ships these in `Regista.app/Contents/Helpers`, built by
`scripts/build-engines.sh` (see THIRD-PARTY-LICENSES.md): Settings › Engines and engines.status then show the
shipped build's licence and size below, not the installable one's above.

| Engine | Shipped licence | Shipped size | Id |
|---|---|---|---|
| FFmpeg | LGPL-2.1-or-later | 8 MB | `ffmpeg` |
| FFprobe | LGPL-2.1-or-later | 8 MB | `ffprobe` |
| whisper.cpp | MIT | 8 MB | `whisper.cpp` |
| DeepFilterNet3 | MIT OR Apache-2.0 | 28 MB | `deepfilternet` |

## Planned, not built

- **SAM 3.1** (`sam-3.1`) — objects tracked by name (issue #37) (SAM License).

## Set up outside the installer

- **Your sound effects**: Optional: put your own sound effects (mp3 / wav files, and a manifest.json if you want descriptions) in ~/Library/Application Support/Regista/sfx, or set sfxLibrary in engines.json to your folder; they are listed next to the shipped bank. Pixabay files cannot ship with Regista: its licence forbids redistributing them as a collection.
- **ComfyUI**: Install ComfyUI by following its own instructions (https://docs.comfy.org), in a Python environment of its own, and put the model files generate.check lists in ComfyUI's models folders (Regista's workflows name each file exactly). Put the comfy-gen command (images and clips) in ~/.local/bin, or set comfyGen in engines.json to where it is; for music and upscale, set comfyRun in engines.json to the comfy_run.py runner. Both read their ComfyUI workflows from a workflows folder beside them. Check it: ask Claude for generate.check (or run scripts/install.sh --with comfyui). It lists every missing node pack and model file, with the ComfyUI folder it goes in.
- **Z-Image Turbo**: Part of the ComfyUI setup: generate.check lists the files this one still needs and the ComfyUI models folder each goes in.
- **Wan 2.2 image-to-video**: Part of the ComfyUI setup: generate.check lists the files this one still needs and the ComfyUI models folder each goes in.
- **ACE-Step 1.5**: Part of the ComfyUI setup: generate.check lists the files this one still needs and the ComfyUI models folder each goes in.
- **Real-ESRGAN + RIFE**: Part of the ComfyUI setup: generate.check lists the files this one still needs and the ComfyUI models folder each goes in.
